responsibilities. Teaching responsibilities are listed on the [Teaching](teaching.qmd) page.

- Associate Editor, IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering (T-ASE), 2022–2025
- Associate Editor, J3eA — Journal sur l'enseignement des sciences et technologies de l'information et des systèmes, since 2024
- Associate Editor for IEEE CASE and IEEE SMC, on behalf of the Technical Committee on Automation in Health Care Management, 2016–2025
- Guest Editor, Special Issue on Automation Science and Engineering for Smart and Interconnected Healthcare Delivery Systems, IEEE T-ASE, vol. 16, no. 1, 2019
- International Program Committee, IFAC Workshop on Discrete Event Systems (WODES), since 2024
- Reviewer for journals — IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, IEEE T-ASE, IEEE Control Systems Letters, Discrete Event Dynamic Systems, Journal of Manufacturing Systems, ASME Journal of Manufacturing Science and Engineering, Personal and Ubiquitous Computing, JESA, MDPI Machines and Applied Sciences — and conferences — IEEE CDC, IEEE/RSJ IROS, IFAC World Congress, IFAC INCOM, MED, MSR

- Co-organiser, with Nacim Ramdani (Université d'Orléans), of the special session Automation Paradigms, Methods and Technologies for Ambient Assisted Living, IEEE CASE 2015, Gothenburg
- Co-organiser, with the co-chairs of the Technical Committee on Automation in Health Care Management, of the special sessions Automation in Health Care Management, IEEE CASE 2014, Taipei
- National Organizing Committee, 12th IFAC Workshop on Discrete Event Systems (WODES'14), Cachan, May 2014
